# US Standard Certificate of Death (NCHS 2003 revision)

> A **documentation-support and validity-classification** form for the [U.S. Standard Certificate of Death](https://www.cdc.gov/nchs/data/dvs/DEATH11-03final-acc.pdf) as completed by the funeral director and the medical certifier. It is not a clinical score, not a diagnostic tool, and **not legal advice**: the registering state agency decides whether a certificate is accepted.
